newsitem.title: USA: Dental Services says president resigns.
newsitem.headline: Dental Services says president resigns.

text.p: Dental Services of America Inc said Monday Paulo Dominguez resigned as president and director.
It said Paul Rothman also resigned as president of Dentall Plans of Florida, its prepaid managed dental care subsidiary. Rothman had previously served as president of Dental Services.
The company declined to comment on why the two resigned.
Dental Services said it named Luis Cruz, its current chairman and the chief executive, both the positions. He will retain those titles.
Cruz recently invested about $1.745 million in the company and is currently its single largest shareholder, it said.
The company also said its board approved a private placement of up to 300,000 shares of series 10, 12 percent redeemable convertible preferred stock at $10 a share.
The company will be accepting minimum investments of $25,000 for units of 2,500 shares. The company said it expects to raise a maximum of $3 million.
